BiblicalUsage: The word names the loops of blue fastened along the edges of the tabernacle curtains, fifty on one curtain and fifty on the next, so the two could be coupled together. The loops held the covering of God's dwelling in place.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the smallest fastening in the tabernacle mattered, because God gave the pattern and His people followed it exactly.
